text_block_list.text:
Having wrapped up today's work,
I was heading toward the trainer's office when—

Picking it up, I took a closer look.
It appeared to be a looped ribbon, but...

"Ah, you there!
Could it be...? Wow, thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"This is Maru-chan's sash!
What do you think, does it suit me?"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "I carelessly dropped it, but you picking it up really saved the day!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"I'll have to sew it on nice and tight from now on!
Truly, thank you so much!"
The one speaking while manipulating the puppet was Marche Lorraine. While it was common to see her using puppets――

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"What's wrong? Why are you staring so hard?!
Maru-chan's getting embarrassed~!"
choice_data_list: Is this little guy handmade? That's amazing...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you!
It makes me so happy to be praised☆"
choice_data_list: Do you put on puppet shows anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Unfortunately, I don't have any plans for that right now!
Though of course, anytime you wish for it♪"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Even so, did you take that much of a liking to Maru-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Is it because I'm adorable and look like I'd spread love?
Or maybe because I'm full of energy~.
Fufu, that really makes me happy."

The puppet moved and talked so skillfully
that I found myself watching with childlike fascination.
choice_data_list: It's so full of life—truly amazing!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
...T-Th――
'I can't believe you're praising me so much!
Ahaha, tell me more! Just kidding~'
choice_data_list: I feel like your expression shifts every time you speak.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Maru-chan's actually very expressive!
You can totally tell what Maru-chan's feeling, can't you?"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: ! ……Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
"Thank you~!"
While the puppet wore a cheerful smile, behind it... Marche Lorraine looked fidgety and restless...

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
G... "Guess it's a no-go today!
Your hands are totally empty right now, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Oops, look at the time!
I really must be going now.
...Thank you for everything. See ya!"

...She ran off as if fleeing.
Perhaps that was her roundabout way of turning me down.

Was asking her to "teach me" out of the blue
a bit too rude...? Just as I was reflecting and planning to apologize a few days later—
On top of the desk sat a book titled "Easy! How to Make Puppets"...
